mathematical_result.name: QFORM-UNEQUAL-BANK-EDGEWORTH-SIGN-v1
mathematical_result.scope: Exact three-bank cap-one uniform product family with arbitrary unequal bank sizes, arbitrary O(3) rotation, exact nonzero spectrum {1,1,-1}; cone-tip asymptotics as min bank size tends to infinity.
mathematical_result.statement: p_Q(0)/(3sqrt(2)) = 1 - sum_j h(O_{3j}^2)/(20 m_j) + O((sum_j 1/m_j)^2), where h(u)=(57+6u-39u^2)/32 >= 3/4 on [0,1]. Thus every bank's first Edgeworth correction is negative and the relative deficit is at least (3/80) sum_j 1/m_j up to quadratic error.
mathematical_result.continuity: proved for this finite witness family only

partner_result_applied.application: For the partner rational rotation u=(9,36,4)/49, the new bankwise coefficients sum to (1/20) sum h(u_j)=5295/21952, exactly recovering the partner equal-bank coefficient. The partner exact family also yields C_*>=3sqrt(2), giving limsup cone-tip <=3sqrt(2)<=C_* for this unequal-bank class.

unresolved_implication: This is only a cone-tip asymptotic stress-family theorem. It does not control off-tip global modes, arbitrary cap-one marginals, shared mesoscopic physical rows, finite-leverage survivors, or arbitrary added spectrum.
next_step: Leave the independent three-bank CLT architecture: test an exact source-valid shared-mesoscopic-row or off-tip family whose limiting non-Gaussian component is not merely an independent random shift of the minimum-variance Gaussian core.
